description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the settings_tray module, including help text, view alterations, entity type modifications, toolbar adjustments, block modifications, and CSS alterations.

classes.name: SettingsTrayHooks
classes.description: A class implementing various Drupal hooks for the settings_tray module, managing help content, contextual links, block views, entity types, toolbar, block definitions, and CSS.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the settings_tray module, including permissions and usage instructions.

methods.name: contextualLinksViewAlter
methods.description: Alters the contextual links view to reorder links and attach necessary libraries.

methods.name: blockViewAlter
methods.description: Modifies block view arrays to add metadata and prevent stale client-side data.

methods.name: entityTypeBuild
methods.description: Adds form class and link template for block entity types.

methods.name: toolbarAlter
methods.description: Adjusts the contextual toolbar tab for users with block administration permissions.

methods.name: blockAlter
methods.description: Ensures all block plugins have a 'settings_tray' form and class.

methods.name: cssAlter
methods.description: Alters CSS inclusion order for settings_tray theme CSS.
